studies.title: Nattokinase and Arterial Plaque
studies.tested: Nattokinase, an enzyme from natto (fermented soybeans), 6,000 FU a day
studies.result: The study reported a reduction in common carotid IMT (the thickness of the artery wall in the neck) and in plaque size.
studies.rating_note: Hermes rates this evidence as early: promising, not proven.

links.label: Ongoing trial: nattokinase and inflammation markers

studies.title: Cherries and Gout Attacks
studies.tested: Cherries or cherry extract eaten in the 2 days before (about half a cup, 10 to 12 cherries)
studies.result: Eating cherries in the previous 2 days was linked to a 35% lower chance of a gout attack, and 75% lower for people also taking allopurinol. This kind of study shows a link, not proof.

studies.title: Exercise Lying Down for POTS
studies.tested: Exercise done lying back or seated (recumbent bike, rowing, swimming), built up from 10-20 minutes to 40-45 minutes, 4 to 6 days a week
studies.result: Among people who finished the program, 71% no longer met the criteria for POTS. That number only counts the people who finished.

studies.title: Pumpkin Seeds for Prostate (GRANU)
studies.tested: Pumpkin seed extract, plain pumpkin seeds, or a placebo
studies.who: 1,431 men aged 50 to 80 with enlarged prostate symptoms
studies.result: The pumpkin seed extract did no better than the placebo. Plain pumpkin seeds did a little better (58.5% improved vs 47.3% on placebo), but that part wasn't fully blinded.

studies.title: The Tomato Trial That Never Started (SOLANUM)
studies.who: Planned: people with plaque in the neck (carotid) arteries
studies.result: Withdrawn before anyone enrolled because of lack of funding. There are no results.

studies.title: Vitamin D and Autoimmune Disease (VITAL)
studies.tested: Vitamin D, 2,000 units a day, vs a placebo
studies.result: Fewer people on vitamin D got an autoimmune disease: 123 vs 155 on placebo, 22% fewer. The result was right on the edge of counting as real. Fish oil in the same trial made no clear difference.

studies.title: Vitamin D Doses for MS
studies.tested: Vitamin D, 1,000 vs 4,000 units a day, in winter
studies.result: Completed in April 2018, but no results were ever posted on the trial registry.

studies.title: Interval Walking for Rheumatoid Arthritis
studies.tested: Walking 3 times a week, 30 minutes, with 10 bursts of at least 1 minute at high effort
studies.who: 12 inactive adults with rheumatoid arthritis, average age 64
studies.result: Disease activity scores dropped 38% and fitness went up about 9%. Only 12 people and no comparison group.

studies.title: Meditation and Yoga for Lupus
studies.tested: Group sessions of meditation, yoga, group talks and deep breathing
studies.result: Completed in June 2018, but no results were ever posted on the trial registry.

studies.title: Raw Plant Diet and Lupus
studies.tested: Mostly raw, whole-food plant diet heavy on leafy greens, with flax or chia seeds and lots of water
studies.result: The report says nearly all symptoms faded within 4 weeks, and two stayed symptom-free 6+ years with no recent medication. Only 3 people, and the lead author sells a program for this diet.
